definitions.explanation: A Japanese national holiday on August 11, created in 2016 to give people a chance to enjoy the mountains and be grateful for their blessings.

examples.japanese: ⟦{明日|あした}→明日：00501_ashita⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{山|やま}の{日|ひ}だ。
{山|やま}の{日|ひ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{八月|はちがつ}→八月：00626_hachigatsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{祝日|しゅくじつ}→祝日：07588_shukujitsu⟧だ。
examples.english: Mountain Day is a holiday in August.

examples.japanese: {山|やま}の{日|ひ}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦お{盆|ぼん}→お盆：05587_obon⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{休|やす}み→休み：02266_yasumi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧つなげて、⟦{帰省|きせい}→帰省：12419_kisei⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: Many people link Mountain Day with the Obon break and go back to their hometowns.

notes:
The newest of Japan's national holidays (first observed in 2016). Because it falls just before ⟦お{盆|ぼん}→お盆：05587_obon⟧, many workplaces run it into a longer summer break.
